series_short_description: Pulled barefoot from their studio sofa into Vaeloria, Nolan (24) and Gwen (19) journey on crutches home.
series_description: After losing their paternal grandfather the day before Gwen turned eighteen, twenty-four-year-old Nolan Lennox (5'7") rushed his six-foot-one younger sister Gwen into his tiny studio apartment before the state could separate them, proudly adding her name to the lease days later. A year on—just past Gwen's nineteenth birthday, worn down by broken elevators and six-week wheelchair part denials—an amber stained-glass rift answers Gwen's spoken wish right over their coffee table, pulling barefoot Nolan, Gwen, Grandpa Walter's plaid blanket, and their four ergonomic Lofstrand forearm crutches into the twin-moon 1980s fantasy realm of Vaeloria while leaving both wheelchairs behind. Called by the Slow-Footed Order's sleeping Astrolabe to heal The Great Drift, you choose at every Story Crossroads which gentle road the affectionate brother and sister take toward a forever home they never want to leave.

crossroads.kicker: Story Crossroads • Second Afternoon of the Twin Moons, The Sunken Milestone
crossroads.title: Three Gentle Roads Toward the Waystation: How Do Nolan and Gwen Travel?
crossroads.prompt: With both wheelchairs left behind in Studio 2B on Earth, barefoot twenty-four-year-old Nolan Lennox and his six-foot-one nineteen-year-old sister Gwen have learned why Vaeloria's sleeping Astrolabe answered Gwen's wish: only two inseparable, unhurried hearts can re-harmonize the twin rings and heal The Great Drift. Here at the Sunken Milestone, peddler Bramwell Kettle shows them three gentle 1980s-fantasy routes winding inward. Every option opens a complete, coequal story route.

options.label: The Glasswater Lantern-Barge Canal
options.subtitle: Step onto barge-master Maren's wide reed-and-cedar lantern boat—cuddling barefoot on cushioned planks with forearm crutches stowed safe beside the gunwale while Gwen's astronomy eye guides the barge through the misty stars of The Great Drift.

options.label: The Whisperwood Cushion-Moss Road
options.subtitle: Walk unhurriedly at your own forearm-crutch pace over three-inch velvet moss laid by the Slow-Footed Order, soaking bare feet in 98-degree mineral springs and curling up together in cozy stone shelters as your shared footsteps reawaken sleepy forest lanterns.

options.label: The Brass Counterweight Gondola Way
options.subtitle: Board the oak-and-brass water-balanced sky gondola rising smoothly into the Amber Crags past singing bronze wind-harps, helping the cliffside Star-Keepers recalibrate moon-rings knocked out of phase by The Great Drift.

parts.excerpt: Every broken subway elevator and locked "out-of-order" wheelchair lift Nolan and I had ever stared at in the rain got its cosmic apology the moment we rolled through the lower pavilion of the Brass Counterweight…
parts.image_alt: Against a sweeping 1980s fantasy sunset of painted gold-and-violet clouds and twin rising moons in the Amber Crags, barefoot 5-foot-7 Nolan Lennox and his taller 6-foot-1 sister Gwen Lennox cuddle warmly together in an affectionate hug inside their green-and-navy plaid sofa blanket on the wide oak bench of an ornate open brass-and-oak counterweight cable gondola gliding past cliffside arches and bronze wind-harps, with their silver and charcoal single-tube Lofstrand forearm crutches resting beside the armrests.
